findings.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')

This directly addresses CWE-1321 by preventing unsafe modifications of object prototype attributes. The change strengthens the control mechanism against prototype pollution, but the exact path from upstream input to this function call remains unspecified.
